lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Performance task: plan: the equivalence proof wall

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: This example shows how to plan before computing anything.

items.prompt: Generate a fraction equivalent to 2/5 by multiplying the numerator and denominator by the same number.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Decide what the quantities are before you compute anything.

items.prompt: Generate a fraction equivalent to 4/6 by multiplying the numerator and denominator by the same number.
Generate a fraction equivalent to 3/5 by multiplying the numerator and denominator by the same number.

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Plan in writing: what you will figure out, how, and how you will check it.

items.prompt: Generate a fraction equivalent to 7/8 by multiplying the numerator and denominator by the same number.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: Generate a fraction equivalent to 3/6 by multiplying the numerator and denominator by the same number.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
